_doc: Revert-verify mutants for vault-exodev ems__Bug 290965dd: sameTerm compares RDF terms, a query constant included (SPARQL 1.1 §17.4.1.8, RDF 1.1 literal term equality). Each mutant removes one guarantee and must redden exactly the axes in `expect` (pairwise distinct within the spec). `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header `● <suite> › <axis> ` (ITRV §A44/§A104). Anchors are CODE lines only. `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted (§A145). Subject: translateTermExpression keeps a constant's lexical form and language tag.

X1_no_lexical._note: The lexical form of a parsed number / boolean is not kept. Red: the written form is lost — T5, T6, T16; NaN does not survive the JSON clone into EXISTS — T14; the non-canonical node carries no lexical — T22.

X2_no_language._note: The language tag of a constant is not kept. Red: T7 and T15 (constants against "x"@ru), T29 (""@en and ""@fr become one unbuildable constant).

X3_lexical_only_for_numbers._note: Review MA: the lexical form is kept for numbers only — "0"^^xsd:boolean becomes false (T16), ""^^xsd:boolean the buildable "false" (T27).

X4_no_named_node_flag._note: An IRI constant is not marked — sameTerm takes it as a string (the old path). Red: T17, T21, T26, T27.

X5_lexical_always._note: Spec 290965dd: the lexical form is kept even where `value` prints it back — `0` gets lexical "0" and stops being the node an engine-made constant is (a translation into `0 - A`, as the unary-minus fix of ems__Bug 151b98a1 in PR #4607 does, compares node for node). sameTerm answers on finite canonical constants do not change (constantTerm falls back to String(value)), so only the node-shape axis reddens: T22.
X5_lexical_always.from: const canonical = String(value) === term.value && (typeof value === "boolean" || Number.isFinite(value));

X6_nan_canonical._note: Spec review L3: NaN / Infinity count as canonical, so their lexical form is not kept — a JSON clone of the plan (EXISTS substitution) turns the value into null and the constant into "null". Red: T14 (NaN), T31 (Infinity).
X6_nan_canonical.from: const canonical = String(value) === term.value && (typeof value === "boolean" || Number.isFinite(value));
X6_nan_canonical.to: const canonical = String(value) === term.value && (typeof value === "boolean" || typeof value === "number");

X7_infinity_canonical._note: Spec review round 2 V6: only NaN counts as non-canonical (isNaN instead of isFinite) — Infinity loses its lexical form in the JSON clone into EXISTS. Red: T31.
X7_infinity_canonical.from: const canonical = String(value) === term.value && (typeof value === "boolean" || Number.isFinite(value));
